title: 第25章 木兰从军第26章 第一次出任务
slug: 一剑惊天下可她身后的男人更可怕
content_zh:
训练场上，赵老兵抱着胳膊，看向一旁的刀疤脸：
“刀疤，你‘穿林’的最好记录是多少来着？”
刀疤脸得意地一扬下巴，露出标志性的疤痕笑容：
“三分二十九息！整个甲队第三！”
赵老兵点点头，手指却指向君傲：“这个新人罗卜，今天第一次跑‘穿林’，用时……两分十七息。”
空气安静了一瞬。
刀疤脸上的笑容僵住了，他慢慢转过头，盯着君傲，眼神像见了鬼。
两分十七息？
这比他的最佳记录快了足足一分！
在神策营，每一项训练记录的提升都是以“息”为单位计算的，快上十息都算显著进步，这一分多……
“罗、罗卜……”刀疤张了张嘴，半晌才憋出一句，“兄弟我看走眼了……你这腿脚，是装了风火轮吧？”
君傲挠挠头，露出人畜无害的憨笑：
“刀疤大哥过奖了。我就是从小跑得快，身子灵活点。真论起其他本事，比如刀法力气，还有脑子，肯定比不上各位大哥。”
这话说得诚恳，刀疤心里那点不平衡顿时消了大半。
也是，神策营里谁没点绝活？
有人像蛮牛一样扛揍，有人箭术百步穿杨，有人心思缜密如狐。
这罗卜大概就是天生敏捷超常，其他方面平平。
然而，接下来几天的训练，彻底颠覆了刀疤等人的认知。
负重奔袭，君傲扛着比别人多一倍的沙袋，第一个冲过终点，面不改色。
拳脚对练。

他凭借鬼魅般的身法和精准的时机把握，将几个第五境的老兵耍得团团转。
陷阱辨识与破解。
他学得飞快，往往赵老兵只演示一遍，他就能举一反三，甚至找出更优解。
就连最考验意志的“寒潭静坐”。
这个看起来细皮嫩肉的新人。
也硬生生坐满了两个时辰，上来时嘴唇发紫，浑身打颤，却咧着嘴笑。
“我说萝卜……”刀疤终于忍不住，在饭堂里勾住君傲脖子，一脸崩溃，“你丫的到底是不是人？怎么啥都行？！”
君傲扒拉着碗里的糙米饭，含糊道：“刀疤哥，我也想低调，可实力它不允许啊……”
这话说得欠揍。
但配上他那副无辜的表情，刀疤只能翻个白眼，狠狠捶了他一拳。
君傲嘴上这么说，心里其实比谁都急。
出风头是其次，他真正渴望的是实战，是杀敌！
来到神策营两个多月，每日重复着枯燥的训练，修为停滞在第四境初期，寸步未进。
眼看着刀疤、猴子这些老兵在训练和偶尔的丹药辅助下。
气息日渐凝实，自己却只能干瞪眼。
枯燥的训练日复一日。
君傲表现出的全能，让刀疤、赵老兵这些“老人”压力山大。
变着法给他加练，什么“蒙眼穿林”、“负重攀岩”、“一对多混战”……
content_en:
On the training ground, Veteran Zhao crossed his arms and looked at Scarface:
"Scar, what's your best record of 'walking through the forest'?"
Scarface raised his chin proudly and showed his iconic scarred smile:
"Three minutes and twenty-nine breaths! Third in the entire Team A!"
Zhao Laobing nodded, but pointed his finger at Jun Ao: "This newcomer Luo Bu ran through the forest for the first time today, and it took...two minutes and seventeen breaths."
The air was quiet for a moment.
The smile on Scar's face froze. He slowly turned his head and stared at Jun Ao, his eyes as if he had seen a ghost.
Two minutes and seventeen breaths?
This is a full point faster than his best record!
In the Shence Camp, the improvement of each training record is calculated in units of "breaths". A step up to ten breaths is considered a significant improvement. This is more than...
"Luo, Luobu..." Scar opened his mouth and held back a sentence for a while, "Brother, I made a mistake... Are your legs and feet equipped with Hot Wheels?"
Jun Ao scratched his head and showed a harmless smile:
"Brother Scar, thank you. I've just been able to run fast and be flexible since I was little. When it comes to other abilities, such as swordsmanship, strength, and brains, I'm definitely not as good as you guys."
These words were said sincerely, and most of the imbalance in Scar's heart disappeared immediately.
Also, who in the Shence camp doesn’t have some unique skills?
Some people can bear the beating like a bull, some people can shoot through a tree at a hundred steps, and some people are as thoughtful as a fox.
This carrot is probably born with extraordinary agility, but is mediocre in other aspects.
However, the training in the next few days completely overturned the perceptions of Scar and others.
Running with a heavy load, Jun Ao was the first to cross the finish line, carrying twice as many sandbags as others, without changing his expression.
Fist and kick sparring.
With his ghostly movement skills and precise timing, he fooled several veterans of the Fifth Realm around.
Trap identification and cracking.
He learns very quickly. Often, after Zhao Laobing demonstrates something once, he can draw inferences from one example and even find a better solution.
Even the "cold pool meditation" that tests the will most.
This newcomer looks thin and tender.
I sat there for two hours, and when I came up, my lips were purple, my whole body was trembling, but I was grinning.
"I said carrot..." Scar finally couldn't help it, and hooked Jun Ao's neck in the dining hall, with a look of collapse on his face, "Are you a human being? How come you can do anything?!"
Jun Ao picked up the brown rice in the bowl and said vaguely: "Brother Scar, I also want to keep a low profile, but my strength doesn't allow it..."
This sounds like a slap in the face.
But with his innocent expression, Scar could only roll his eyes and punch him hard.
Jun Ao said this, but he was actually more anxious than anyone else.
The limelight is second, what he really desires is actual combat, killing the enemy!
I have been in Shence Camp for more than two months, repeating boring training every day, and my cultivation has stagnated at the early stage of the fourth realm, making no progress.
Seeing veterans like Scar and Monkey with the help of training and occasional pills.
The aura was getting stronger day by day, but he could only stare.
Boring training day after day.
Jun Ao's almighty performance puts "old people" like Scar and Zhao Lao Lao under a lot of pressure.
Give him additional training in different ways, such as "blindfolded walking through the forest", "weight-bearing rock climbing", "one-to-many melee"...
